info.title: FAR 52 219 9 Subcontracting Plan eSRS Calculator API
info.description: Calculates Small Business subcontracting dollar and percentage goals across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone categories (under both % of Total Subcontracted Dollars and % of Total Contract Value baselines), drafts the 15 mandatory elements of a FAR 52.219-9 Small Business Subcontracting Plan and DFARS 252.219-7003 Small Business Participation Commitment Document (SBPCD), and structures eSRS ISR/SSR reporting and FAR 52.219-16 Liquidated Damages good-faith effort controls. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate FAR 52.219-9 Subcontracting Plan & eSRS Socioeconomic Goals
post.description: Calculates FAR 52.219-9 & DFARS 252.219-7003 Small Business Subcontracting Plan goals across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone, drafts all 15 FAR 52.219-9(d) elements, and structures eSRS ISR/SSR reporting.

solicitation_subcontracting_and_clin_tex.description: Total contract ceiling, Base + Option period breakdown, total planned subcontracted dollars, RFP Section L/M Small Business Participation factor targets, and named subcontractor commitments.

plan_type_and_regulatory_regime.description: Subcontracting Plan structure: Individual Plan, Master Plan + Individual Goals, or Commercial Subcontracting Plan under FAR 52.219-9 / DFARS 252.219-7003.

agency_socioeconomic_goal_benchmarks.description: Agency statutory or RFP-mandated small business subcontracting goal percentages across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone.

example.solicitation_subcontracting_and_clin_tex: Total 5-Year IDIQ Task Order Ceiling: $50,000,000 (Base Year $10M + Four 1-Year Options at $10M/yr). Total Planned Subcontracted Spend: $20,000,000 (40.0% of Total Contract Value). Section M Small Business Participation Factor requires >= 25% of Total Contract Value ($12.5M) or >= 62.5% of Total Subcontracted Spend awarded to Small Businesses, including SDB/8(a) Cyber Sentinel LLC (NAICS 541512, $3.5M), SDVOSB Valor Cloud Solutions (NAICS 541519, $3.0M), WOSB Athena Analytics Inc. (NAICS 541511, $2.5M), and HUBZone Appalachian DevSecOps Corp (NAICS 541512, $1.5M).
